1. ESTABLISH – RESIDENTIAL PERMIT PARKING AREA S (Eligibility only, no signs)
24th Street, both sides, between Noe Street and Sanchez Street (Supervisor District 8) (Requires
approval by the SFMTA Board) Lulu Brien, [staff email removed — see the order]

Extending RPP Area S to this block facing restricted street parking will allow the residents to purchase
parking permits for their vehicle to park within Area S.

Public Comments: No comments.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and
implementation.

AREA O PERMITS



Yerba Buena Avenue, both sides, between Santa Paula Avenue and San Pablo Avenue (Supervisor
District 7) (Requires approval by the SFMTA Board) Lulu Brien, [staff email removed — see the order]

This change is requested by a signed petition from the residents of the block and will add 2-hour area
O RPP parking, Mon-Fri from 8 AM to 6 PM, to the 100-148 block of Yerba Buena Avenue, both sides,
between Santa Paula Avenue and San Pablo Avenue

Public Comments: Received email in support prior to public hearing. No comments received during
public hearing.

implementation.
